articles.title: Spain dominates the new FIFPro World XI with four players, without the Ballon d'Or
articles.standfirst: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.summary: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the eleven best players of last season, with Harry Kane's absence standing out
articles.body:
The Spanish National Team has been recognized for the World Cup won in the United States with the inclusion of four of its players in the FIFPro World XI . David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal have been chosen by their own teammates among the best eleven players of last season.

In the midst of a World Cup year , voters have had to choose from the last 26 finalists the 11 best players of the past campaign. The previous edition was dominated by PSG , with as many as five footballers from Luis Enrique’s team. This season, four Spaniards feature in the FIFPro World XI: David Raya, Pau Cubarsí, Rodri Hernández and Lamine Yamal.

As in the previous season, there is still significant representation from the Parisian side, two-time Champions League winner , with Achraf Hakimi, Nuno Mendes and Vitinha.

On Real Madrid's side, the presence of Jude Bellingham and Kylian Mbappé stands out. In a lineup in which the absence of the brand-new Ballon d'Or winner, Harry Kane , is striking, the other two spots are filled by Erling Haaland and Leo Messi .

Therefore, the FIFPro 2026 World XI is as follows: David Raya; Achraf Hakimi, Pau Cubarsí, Nuno Mendes; Rodri, Vitinha, Bellingham; Messi, Yamal, Mbappé and Haaland.

David Raya has been the player who has accumulated the most votes across all positions . 51.9% of the footballers chose the Arsenal goalkeeper as the best of last season, far ahead of the runner-up; Courtois (38.6%). Among the defenders, Pau Cubarsí, with 26.8%, was only surpassed by Hakimi (40.9%).

Among the midfielders , Rodri leads the list with 33.1% , closely followed by Bellingham ( 31.3% ). And in the forwards area, 46% of the voters chose Mbappé , and 37.4% chose Lamine Yamal . Behind them, Messi (29.5%) and Haaland (28.4%) left out Harry Kane (27.6%), in a lineup with four attackers .

An unprecedented situation

The absence of Bayern Munich 's " number nine " is something extraordinary . For the first time since this award began in 2005 , the winner of the Ballon d'Or that same year has not been included afterward in the ideal FIFPro team.

The voting was carried out by 19,806 footballers from 73 countries who assessed "their performances between 4 August 2025 and 19 July 2026 , both inclusive, during which they must have played at least 30 official matches".

With the four appearances in this new edition, Spain widens its lead as the country with the highest number of appearances in the Men's World XI , with 53 selections shared among 17 players . In addition, Lamine Yamal becomes the first player in history to appear for the second time in the FIFPro World XI before the age of 20.

articles.title: "We're going to take advantage of it": Araújo's provocative remark about Messi before Argentina-Uruguay that heats up the friendly
articles.standfirst: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.summary: The Uruguayan defender, who shared a locker room with the former Argentine captain at Barcelona, anticipated how La Celeste will try to take advantage of the No. 10's absence and left a remark that fired up the buildup to the clásico at La Bombonera.
articles.body:
The Argentina national team will face a special test this Friday, November 13, when it hosts Uruguay at La Bombonera. It will be its first match after Lionel Messi 's farewell from the national team and, ahead of the game, people from La Celeste have already started heating up the Río de la Plata clásico with controversial statements.

One of those who spoke was Ronald Araújo, who knows the Argentine captain very well from having shared a dressing room with him at Barcelona. The Uruguayan defender did not avoid the subject of his absence and issued a warning that quickly drew attention: "In the end they lost the best player in the world, and we're going to take advantage of that."

Araújo's warning to the Argentina national team over Messi

The footballer made it clear that Uruguay will try to take advantage of the Albiceleste's new reality. However, he also acknowledged that Lionel Scaloni's team retains significant pedigree and that it will not be easy to face them. "They have great players, they have young players with a lot of quality, they are a great powerhouse", he said.

Araújo also highlighted the difficulty of facing Argentina and anticipated that Uruguay will seek to impose its style of play . "All matches against Argentina are difficult, but we are going to show our football and continue growing as a national team" added the defender, who is preparing for one of the most attractive matches of the FIFA international break.

Araújo will have a special duel with Alexis Mac Allister

The clásico will also have a particular twist for the Uruguayan defender: on the other side will be Alexis Mac Allister, his teammate at Liverpool. Araújo acknowledged that there had already been some joking between the two footballers ahead of the match. "We've already teased each other a little," he said, referring to the clash with his eyes on a duel that will have a special edge because it is Scaloni's first match without Messi.

The match will mark the beginning of a new era for the Argentine national team, which will have to face its commitments without the presence of its historic captain.

After the match against Uruguay, Scaloni's team will face Costa Rica on Tuesday, November 17, in Córdoba.

While Argentina will seek to show that it remains competitive without Messi, Uruguay will arrive hoping to take advantage of the new scenario.
